beats.label: What happens
beats.text: When work hours clash with your **sleep** time for 3+ months, it can become **shift** **work** **disorder.**
beats.note: AASM guideline, J Clin Sleep Med, Oct 2026

beats.label: How common
beats.text: About **27%** of adult shift workers live with it.

beats.label: For sleepiness
beats.text: The new guideline lists **caffeine,** planned **naps** and **bright light** as options.

beats.label: For your clock
beats.text: Timed **light,** a **steady** sleep schedule when you can, and **light-filtering** on the drive home.

beats.label: For poor sleep
beats.text: **CBT** for **insomnia,** plus **melatonin** to discuss with a doctor.

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: Evidence for the caffeine, nap and light tips is **low-certainty.** A **sleep doctor** can tailor a plan.
Follow if your day starts when **everyone else's** ends.
